sources.title: Gemma 4 | Google AI Edge | Google for Developers
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 models are designed to deliver frontier-level performance at each size, targeting deployment scenarios from mobile and edge devices (E2B, E4B) to consumer GPUs and workstations (26B A4B, 31B). They are well-suited for reasoning, agentic workflows, coding, and multimodal understanding. Note: LiteRT-LM supports E2B and E4B models today, with support for larger models coming soon.
